teacher_profiles.bio: Lead Full-Stack Web Development Architect & Classroom Instructor with 12+ years of production experience.

courses.title: HTML5 Semantic Web Architecture
courses.description: Master modern semantic markup, accessible forms, audio/video integration, and document layout foundations.

courses.title: Modern CSS3 & Responsive Design
courses.description: Deep dive into Flexbox, CSS Grid, custom properties, animations, and Tailwind utility systems.

courses.title: JavaScript Deep Dive & DOM Engineering
courses.description: Core language mechanisms, closures, prototypes, asynchronous JavaScript, Promises, and the Event Loop.

courses.title: TypeScript for Production Web Apps
courses.description: Static typing, interfaces, generics, utility types, unions, and configuring strict type safety.

courses.title: React 18 & Enterprise Component Architecture
courses.description: Hooks, state management, context, TanStack Query caching, custom hooks, and memoization patterns.

courses.title: Firebase Cloud Mastery & Push Notifications
courses.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), Cloud Firestore, Authentication, and real-time client sync.

courses.title: Supabase & PostgreSQL Full-Stack Architecture
courses.description: Relational data modeling, Row-Level Security (RLS) policies, Supabase Storage buckets, and Edge functions.

topics.title: Introduction to HTML5
topics.description: History, document declaration, viewport configuration, and metadata.

topics.title: HTML Structure & Semantics
topics.description: Header, nav, main, section, article, aside, and footer elements.

topics.title: Headings & Paragraphs
topics.description: Typography hierarchy, line breaks, and text formatting tags.

topics.title: Links & Images
topics.description: Hyperlinks, image optimization, responsive picture tags, and alt text.

topics.title: Forms & Input Validation
topics.description: Creating interactive user input forms, radio buttons, selects, and attributes.

topics.title: Tables & Tabular Data
topics.description: Thead, tbody, tfoot, scope, colspan, and rowspan for clean tables.

topics.title: The CSS Box Model & Selectors
topics.description: Margins, borders, padding, content box vs border box, specificity.

topics.title: Flexbox Layout Essentials
topics.description: Justify-content, align-items, flex direction, grow, shrink, and wrap.

topics.title: CSS Grid & Modern Two-Dimensional Layouts
topics.description: Grid template columns, minmax, auto-fit, auto-fill, and grid areas.

topics.title: Modern ES6+ Syntax & Scope
topics.description: Let, const, arrow functions, destructuring, and template literals.

topics.title: Asynchronous JS, Promises & Async/Await
topics.description: Handling asynchronous workflows, try/catch, fetch API, and microtask queues.

topics.title: TypeScript Fundamentals & Type Annotations
topics.description: Primitives, arrays, tuples, enums, and type inference.

topics.title: Generics & Advanced Utility Types
topics.description: Generic functions, Pick, Omit, Partial, and conditional types.

topics.title: React Hooks Core (useState, useEffect)
topics.description: Component lifecycles, effect dependencies, cleanups, and synchronization.

topics.title: Custom Hooks & State Encapsulation
topics.description: Extracting reusable business logic into clean custom hooks.

topics.title: Firebase Push Notifications with FCM
topics.description: Service workers, device token registration, payload construction, and delivery.

topics.title: PostgreSQL Schema Design & Constraints
topics.description: Foreign keys, indexes, triggers, and cascading constraints.

topics.title: Supabase Storage & Access Control
topics.description: Creating secure buckets for avatars, video assets, and signed URLs.

assignments.title: HTML5 Semantic Web Architecture & Portfolio
assignments.description: Design and code a fully accessible, semantic multi-page HTML portfolio following modern HTML5 web standards.
assignments.instructions: Create an accessible, semantic HTML5 structure including <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <aside>, and <footer> tags. Implement structured form controls with validation attributes.
requirements: Use valid HTML5 doctype and meta tags for responsive viewport
Include semantic tags: header, nav, main, article, section, footer
Build a comprehensive contact form with required field validation
Validate markup using W3C HTML validator without errors
Submit source files inside a PDF document or design image (PNG, JPG, WEBP) documentation

assignments.title: Modern CSS Flexbox & Grid Dashboard Layout
assignments.description: Construct a responsive multi-column SaaS analytics dashboard layout using CSS Flexbox and modern CSS Grid techniques.
assignments.instructions: Implement mobile-first responsive breakpoints. Utilize CSS custom properties (variables) for theme consistency. Ensure no horizontal page overflow across screen widths from 320px to 1920px.
requirements: Mobile-first responsive design using CSS Flexbox and Grid
Use CSS custom properties (variables) for colors and typography
Smooth hover micro-animations and transition states
Clean, well-commented vanilla CSS stylesheet without frameworks

assignments.title: Interactive JavaScript DOM Quiz Application
assignments.description: Build an interactive web-based quiz application that dynamically renders questions, tracks scores, and stores high scores in localStorage.
assignments.instructions: Use modern ES6+ syntax (arrow functions, template literals, destructuring). Handle DOM event listeners cleanly. Implement a countdown timer and dynamic results summary.
requirements: Dynamic rendering of questions from a JavaScript array of objects
Score tracking with localStorage high-score persistence
